Name: Meadow Farm Style Fences and Gates (CP)(AT)
Author: Gurrabird
Description:
[size=4][b]Description:[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8][size=4][CP] and [AT] versions of fences and gates designed to coordinate with the style of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5787]East Scarp Remastered[/url]'s Meadow Farm house and related Meadow Farm style mods. Included are multiple wood and stone fences with coordinating gates in a range of Meadow Farm colors and textures.  [/size][/color]


[size=4][b]Installation:[/b][/size]

[color=#D4D4D8][u][b][AT] Alternative Textures: [/b][/u]
Download and install/unzip the [AT] version into your mods folder. Once installed, use the paint bucket to select textures and the paint brush to quickly spread over a length of fence.

[b][u][CP] Content Patcher:[/u][/b]
Download and install/unzip the [CP] version into your mods folder. Once installed, any existing or newly installed craftable fences or gates should have the default styles of this mod. If you have other Content Patcher path/flooring mods installed, you may need to select this one specifically, disable the others in the Generic Mod Config Menu or remove them from your mods folder.

[i]Customization options in the Generic Mod Config Menu:[/i][/color]

[list]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Select to disable the fences or gate in this mod if you want to mix and match with other textures. Default setting is enabled for all.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Select style: Choose which design to use as the default for the wood fence, stone fence and gate.[/color][/*]
[/list]

[size=4][b]Requirements:[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Alternative Textures / Required only for AT version[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Content Patcher / Required only for CP versions[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]SMAPI[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Stardew Valley Expanded[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Generic Mod Config Menu[/color][/*]
[/list]

[size=4][b]Credits and appreciation:[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]Lemurkat/[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5787]East Scarp Remastered[/url] for the unique look of the Meadow Farmhouse that this is based on and permission to post this.[/color]
